codes.meaning: The evaluation request failed the strict v1 shape or value contract.

The request does not bind the exact policy identifier, version, and digest.

A detected trigger is absent from the policy's closed priority and ordinary trigger vocabularies.
At least one monotonic priority trigger is present.
At least one monotonic ordinary-review trigger is present.
The artifact type is outside the ratified auto-admission allowlist.
Independent semantic review was not demonstrated.
Reviewer evidence conflicts with deterministic checks.
The reviewer identified one or more unsupported claims.
The reviewer identified one or more contradictions.
The artifact and its evidence do not share an applicable scope.
The proposed derived artifact is not reversible.
The proposed derived artifact is not reconstructable from retained inputs.
All monotonic gates passed and the artifact type is explicitly allowlisted.
